title: MEDIEVAL KNIGHTMARE
description:
ABOUT THE GAMEMedieval Knightmare is a cooperative multiplayer first person game where you will fight against large hordes of monsters that try to invade the village, your objective will be to protect the gates from these enemies preventing them from reaching the king.ENEMIESFight against 10 hordes of different enemies, such as demons, orcs, goblins, zombies and more.. And after finishing the horde a powerful boss will appear.WEAPONSIn the game you can select between 4 weapons:
• Sword, agile and powerful but with a great consumption of resistance.
• Axe, inflicts great damage but is slower.
• Spear, a fairly fast weapon that can be thrown but without great attack power
• Crossbow, long-range weapon with which you can shoot normal, incendiary or explosive projectilesITEMSThe game contains a lot of different items such as armors, shields, artillery weapons, potions, and more. In order to obtain them you must loot the enemies to sell their parts and buy all the items.
description_short: Hordes of monsters has invaded the village, the last opportunity to avoid them reach the king is you. Arm with weapons and fight the hordes solo or with a team.
